fields.name: URL Encoder/Decoder
fields.description: Encode or decode URLs to make them safe for use in web applications. URL encoding replaces unsafe ASCII characters with a % followed by two hexadecimal digits.

fields.name: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
fields.description: Base64 encoding converts binary data to ASCII characters, making it safe to transmit over text-based protocols. It's commonly used for email attachments and data URIs.

fields.name: MD5 Hash Generator
fields.description: Generate an MD5 hash of any text. MD5 is a widely used cryptographic hash function that produces a 128-bit (16-byte) hash value, typically expressed as a 32-digit hexadecimal number.

fields.name: HTML Encoder/Decoder
fields.description: Encode or decode HTML entities. HTML encoding converts characters like <, >, &, " and ' to their corresponding HTML entities to safely display them on web pages.

fields.name: Caesar Cipher
fields.description: The Caesar Cipher is one of the simplest and most widely known encryption techniques. It works by shifting each letter in the plaintext a certain number of places down the alphabet.

fields.name: SHA-1 Hash Generator
fields.description: Generate a SHA-1 hash of any text. SHA-1 produces a 160-bit (20-byte) hash value, typically rendered as a 40-digit hexadecimal number.

fields.name: SHA-256 Hash Generator
fields.description: Generate a SHA-256 hash of any text. SHA-256 is part of the SHA-2 family and produces a 256-bit (32-byte) hash value, offering improved security over SHA-1.

fields.name: Binary Converter
fields.description: Convert text to binary code and back. Binary encoding represents each character as a sequence of 8 bits (0s and 1s).

fields.name: Hex Encoder/Decoder
fields.description: Convert text to hexadecimal representation and back. Hexadecimal encoding represents each byte as a pair of hexadecimal digits (0-9, A-F).

fields.name: Morse Code Translator
fields.description: Convert text to Morse code and back. Morse code represents characters as sequences of dots and dashes, originally developed for telegraph communication.

fields.name: ROT13 Cipher
fields.description: Apply ROT13 (rotate by 13 places) encoding to text. ROT13 is a simple letter substitution cipher that replaces each letter with the letter 13 positions after it in the alphabet.

fields.name: Atbash Cipher
fields.description: Apply the Atbash cipher to your text. Atbash is a substitution cipher where each letter is replaced by its mirror letter in the alphabet (A→Z, B→Y, etc.).
